description: Two chipped clay pots rest on a table, one small and dark and the other large and slightly lighter. A piece of fabric hangs down from the top of the image and drapes over the table's surface. On the ground next to the hanging fabric, a jug rests on its side. The entire composition is rendered using hatching parallel lines placed close together to denote shading.
